rawText:
CAPTION (as written by the author -- trust these amounts):
Creamy Cajun Chicken Linguine 🌶️🤤

Ingredients (serves 4):
Chicken:
* 2 large chicken breasts, sliced into thin strips
* 1½ tbsp Cajun seasoning
* 1 tsp smoked paprika
* ½ tsp garlic powder
* Salt & pepper (go light if your Cajun seasoning is salty)
* 2 tbsp olive oil
* 1 tbsp butter
Pasta:
* 12 oz linguine
* 1 tbsp butter
Sauce:
* 2 tbsp butter
* 4 cloves garlic, minced
* 1 small shallot, finely diced
* 1 cup heavy cream
* ½ cup whole milk
* ¾ cup freshly grated Parmesan
* ¼ cup Romano cheese (optional but delicious)
* ½ tsp Cajun seasoning (more to taste)
* ½ tsp smoked paprika
* ½ tsp of red pepper flakes 
* Salt to taste
* Juice of ½ lemon
* 1 tbsp chopped parsley

Instructions: 
1. Cook the pasta
Boil linguine until just al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
2. Cook the chicken
Toss chicken with Cajun seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and olive oil. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add butter and cook chicken 3–4 minutes per side until nicely browned. Remove and set aside.
3. Make the sauce
Reduce heat to medium. Add butter, garlic, and shallots. Cook about 2 minutes until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and milk. Simmer 2–3 minutes. Whisk in Parmesan and Romano until smooth.
Season with Cajun seasoning, Smoked paprika, Red pepper flakes. Stir until creamy.
4. Finish
Add the cooked linguine and toss.
If the sauce is too thick, add reserved pasta water a little at a time until silky.
Stir in Lemon juice, Parsley, Roasted red peppers and mushrooms (if using). Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together!
